$comment: Perf budgets for the M0 reference scenes (plan §10, ADR-0007). Draw calls include the colour pass, the moon shadow pass, the G-buffer for line art and character outlines. Frame time is measured under SwiftShader in CI, hence the generous ceiling. market-tpp (M2): the Targ district streamed in, Shinsekai streamed out; measured 182 draw calls / 80 active meshes. ADR-0021 (fire escape, balcony, three ladders and roof parapets on the south row): measured 248 draw calls / 109 active meshes. docks (ADR-0024): east end of the quay looking west (water and mist, crane, office), the docks yard and quay streamed in and nothing else; measured 190 draw calls / 82 active meshes. ADR-0026 (Kenta, Fumiko and Goro behind the north stalls, Sachiko at the kiosk, the people of Ulica Kanałowa down the street behind the gate, the car on the deck): measured 301 draw calls / 120 active meshes; the four market keepers alone are 20 draw calls. ADR-0027 (dressing per chunk, bare-structure skins, far city): reference 102 -> 101 draw calls / 34 -> 35 active meshes, street-tpp 211 -> 210 / 81 -> 82, market-tpp 301 -> 304 / 120 -> 123, docks 190 -> 198 / 82 -> 87; budgets unchanged. ADR-0030 (signs, holo-ads and street reflections in one always-active mesh; the gameplay post-process is off the camera while idle): reference 101 -> 102 / 35 -> 36, street-tpp 210 -> 211 / 82 -> 83, market-tpp 304 -> 305 / 123 -> 124, docks 198 -> 199 / 87 -> 88; budgets unchanged. ADR-0036 (wet-asphalt probe renders only on a district change, trail beams and the metro car are disabled while idle): reference 102 / 36 unchanged, docks 211 / 94 after the wave 2 merges; the metro car alone (models=off) 61 / 12; budgets unchanged. ADR-0038 (clinic and Neon Koi interiors, doors, the barman and two regulars; plain interior blocks merged per preset and 64 m cell, no moon shadow; without the merge 152 / 360): reference 132, street-tpp 301 draw calls; budgets raised to 135 and 305. ADR-0041 (sidewalks baked into the chunk dressing, the crowd of residents in one shared mesh with outline, no moon shadow): reference 132 / 47 unchanged, street-tpp 297 -> 301 / 120 -> 121, market-tpp 303 -> 307 / 123 -> 124, docks 227 / 100 unchanged (empty at night); budgets unchanged. ADR-0045 (the game in Lublin; old scenes street-tpp, market-tpp and docks replaced): measured with the test stepping the game (ADR-0046, models=off, SwiftShader), draw calls / active meshes: reference (Neon Koi in its tenement) 179 / 73, krakowskie-tpp (the deptak west of the clinic, walking east) 369 / 156, rynek-tpp (up Bramowa onto the Rynek) 204 / 80, podzamcze-tpp (the market under the viaduct from its east end) 289 / 114, nabrzeze (the quay at night) 266 / 114, phone-low (800x370, quality low, touch, on the deptak) 231 / 145; the same in two runs. Budgets a few percent above. Frame time is reported in reports/perf.json, not checked (ADR-0046). ADR-0048 (Stare Miasto: gate passages lined, the footbridge, bracket signs, Hebi patrols, Trasa Podziemna in a chunk of its own): rynek-tpp 204 / 80 -> 226 / 86 (at 21:01 a Hebi patrol walks the Rynek in view, 4 meshes, and the TRASA PODZIEMNA sign over the Trybunal's door, 2; the cellars stream in only near the Trybunal, with them in the Rynek's chunk it was 262 / 104); budget 210 / 84 -> 232 / 90; the other scenes unchanged. ADR-0051 (vertical Lublin 2077: superstructures, wall clutter, cables, footbridges and ads baked into the existing cell meshes; the skyline of corporate towers as two impostor meshes, 3 draw calls with the G-buffer): measured before -> after, draw calls / active meshes: reference 179 / 73 -> 185 / 77, krakowskie-tpp 369 / 156 -> 369 / 159, rynek-tpp 226 / 86 -> 232 / 91, podzamcze-tpp 289 / 114 -> 297 / 120, nabrzeze 266 / 114 -> 270 / 117, phone-low 232 / 145 -> 233 / 146 (low: no tower lights); budgets raised a few percent above the new values only where they were exceeded (reference, rynek-tpp, podzamcze-tpp); krakowskie-tpp, nabrzeze and phone-low stay within theirs.
